## About
J&B Auto Recyclers is a family owned shop at 1637 Provincial Rd, between Walker and Cabana, just north of Silver City and Costco. Paul Winkler runs the place, and between him and the rest of the staff there's a lot of know-how about cars under one roof.
We carry used parts and can get new genuine OEM and aftermarket parts too. If you need the part put in, our licensed technician can install it. We also appraise vehicles for Service Ontario, buy scrap cars and sell quality pre-owned vehicles.
We believe in recycling cars the green and friendly way. Reusing parts keeps toxins out of the ground and water and cuts down on new manufacturing. Customers rate us 4.7 from 379 Google reviews.

## Services
- Used and new car parts: Used parts on hand, plus access to new genuine OEM and aftermarket parts.
- Mechanical services: A licensed technician handles engine replacements, minor body repairs, brake jobs and safeties. We can get your part and install it too.
- Automobile appraisals for Service Ontario: Accurate vehicle appraisals for tax purposes. Call to book an appointment.
- Scrap vehicles: We offer a fair price on scrap vehicles and recycle them the green and friendly way. We'll tow it if it doesn't start.
- Quality pre-owned vehicles: A variety of pre-owned vehicles for sale. Call our sales team with any questions.

## FAQ
Q: Can you ship a part to me?
A: Yes. We can ship across the country in just days, and within the province the next day.

Q: Will you tow my scrap car if it won't start?
A: Yes, we'll tow it if your vehicle doesn't start.

Q: How do I find out if you have my part?
A: Give us a call. Our inventory is fully computerized, so we can tell you right away whether we have it or can order it.
